operation_details.item: Earlier, the user planned to submit the paper to NeurIPS.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Morning! Quick update on the federated learning paper: we're officially targeting ICML now. I know I mentioned NeurIPS earlier, but after talking to the collaborators, ICML feels like the better fit.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Morning! That sounds like a solid call. How are the communication-efficient components looking for the ICML version?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pretty good, actually. The core method is holding up well, and we're just doing the final experiment checks this week. Mostly verifying the convergence curves on the last dataset.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice. Are you still on track with the same overall timeline you had before, or did switching from NeurIPS to ICML change your schedule much?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The timeline is actually pretty similar. We're still aiming for the ICML deadline, so the final experiments need to wrap up this week. NeurIPS is officially off the table now.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Got it. If you need another pair of eyes on the experiment results or the figures, I'm happy to take a look before you submit.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Thanks, I'll probably send over the plots tomorrow. The main thing left is checking the compression vs. accuracy trade-off on the last benchmark.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Sounds good. I'll keep some time open later this week so we can do a quick review if you need it.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only my earlier NeurIPS submission plan; retain my current ICML plan and the rest of the project information.
